comparison.objective: Hang a holder on keyhole studs and seat it in the retained position; candidate adjusts proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-stud alignment, large-head passage, translation into narrow slots, and gravity retention versus fine mounted sliding and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: All studs must engage the correct keyhole regions and the holder must remain seated and released; candidate requires two sensed endpoints retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: The record tests keyhole engagement and passive retention, not calibration feedback or locking an adjusted component with screws.
